name: Glance Plus
description: At a Glance with room to grow: the same icon, name and value chips over the screensaver, but you choose how wide and tall each chip is and how many lines the text may wrap to.
author: vswraith

settings.title: Chips
settings.description: Home Assistant entities to show, in order. Up to 12 (16 entities at most can be followed).

fields.title: Name
fields.description: Leave empty to use the entity's own name.

fields.title: Icon
fields.description: Leave empty to use the entity's icon.

settings.title: Show
settings.description: Draw the chips only while the screensaver runs, or over the dashboard as well.

settings.title: Position
settings.description: Where the block of chips sits.

settings.title: Distance from the edge
settings.description: Keep the chips this far from the screen edges.

settings.title: Redraw every
settings.description: Draw the chips again this often, and whenever the screensaver changes what it shows (a new slide can cover them). 0 turns it off.

settings.title: Chips per row
settings.description: How many chips sit side by side before wrapping.

settings.title: Chip width
settings.description: Width of each chip. With Fit to content on, this is the widest a chip may grow.

settings.title: Fit to content
settings.description: Let short chips shrink to their text instead of all being the same width.

settings.title: Chip minimum height
settings.description: Make every chip at least this tall. 0 lets the text decide.

settings.title: Value lines
settings.description: How many lines a value may wrap to before it ends in an ellipsis. The stock row allows one.

settings.title: Name lines
settings.description: How many lines a name may wrap to.

settings.title: Scale
settings.description: Scales the whole row: text, icons, padding and chip width.

settings.title: Hide names
settings.description: Show only the icon and a larger value.

settings.title: Monochromatic icons
settings.description: Keep every icon circle grey instead of colouring it by state.

settings.title: Chip background
settings.description: How solid the dark chip behind the text is.
